verdict.rationale: Duplicate detection and merging is a fair axis for a CRM like Kommo, but the evidence pack has no documentation of detecting duplicate contacts or companies, or of merging them while preserving data. The closest item, linking an incoming lead to an existing lead, is an adjacent lead-level feature and does not deliver contact or company deduplication or merge.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can detect duplicate contacts or companies and merge them without losing data
